meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一篇文章或一个选题,变成图文并茂的解说视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有文字稿或选题,想快速做成能直接发布的解说视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn an article or topic into a graphics-and-text explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a script or topic and want a publishable explainer video fast

howto.what: 把一段文字（文章、笔记、话题或大纲）变成无人出镜的解说视频：画面按场景新造（排版、抽象图形、图表、数据可视化），不截取网站或实拍素材。它会依次产出故事板、脚本、音频，最后渲染出视频文件。
howto.when: 当你要把一段文字或一个话题做成解说视频（话题讲解、概念拆解、操作教程等），且没有网站或实拍素材可截取时接管；意图不明确时会先走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这篇讲复利的文章做成解说视频，配音用 Marcia
say.note: 会逐步产出故事板、脚本，再渲染成片

say.text: 这是我写好的脚本，配音请一字不改地照用
say.note: 脚本按 verbatim 模式保留原话

say.text: 视频保持静音，不要旁白也不要背景音乐
say.note: 在故事板写 music: none 即为静音

howto.what_en: Turns any text — an article, notes, a topic, or a brief — into a faceless explainer video. Visuals are invented per scene (typography, graphics, diagrams); no website or footage is captured. Output: storyboard, script, audio, video.
howto.when_en: Use when you want an explainer video from text or a topic — topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos — with no site or footage to capture. Unclear intent routes to /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Turn this article on compound interest into an explainer, with Marcia's voice
say_en.note: Runs steps: storyboard, script, then render

say_en.text: Here's my script — use my exact wording for the voiceover
Keep the video silent: no narration and no background music
say_en.note: Set music: none in the storyboard
